correctness.rationale: Coordinate swap averaging reduces all positive-definite forms to H_rho²=x²+y²+2rho xy. Hölder duality on the mixed conjugate quadrants shows normalized determinant antinorm equals N_p; the Euclidean antinorm of H_rho yields m_rho*M_rho=1/(1-rho²). On same-sign quadrant R=(1+t^p)^(2/p)/(1+t²+2rho t); f_p(t)=t(1-t^(p-2))/(1-t^p) increases from 0 to alpha. The strictly increasing G_p(s)=(1-s^(p-1))/[(1-s)(1+s^p)^alpha] crosses 2^alpha once, and same/opposite maxima equioscillate there. The source explicitly controls derivatives on either side and rho outside (-alpha,0), proving the global minimax, including p=4 value 6-2sqrt(6). Independent evaluations of balance/branch derivatives checked at several p but do not prove all p.
